transcript.text: To help narrow this down, I need to know exactly what happens when you try to use it. When you press start, do you see any lights or sounds, or is it completely silent? Also, if there is a digital display, are any error codes flashing?
The power light and programme lights come on, but when I press start there's no sound at all. No error codes showing.

Since the lights are on but there's no sound when you press start, the most common cause is that the door isn't fully latched or the child lock is active. Please open the door, make sure no clothing is caught in it, then shut it firmly until you hear a distinct click. Does the dryer start now? If not, check if there's a key or padlock symbol on the display indicating a child lock; usually holding two specific buttons for three seconds turns this off.
I shut the door but there's no click, it just swings back slightly open. Child lock isn't on.

Since the door isn't clicking shut and swings back open, this points to a mechanical issue with the catch (the part that locks) or the hinge, rather than an electrical fault. Before we look at parts, I need to know exactly which model you have so I can check compatibility. Could you please tell me the make and model number of your tumble dryer? This is usually found on a sticker inside the door frame or on the back panel.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
It's a Hotpoint. I don't know the model number offhand, I'll have a look inside the door recess and see what it says.

That sounds like a mechanical failure of the door catch or hinge—the plastic part that locks into the frame has likely broken, which is why it won't click shut. This is a common wear-and-tear issue on tumble dryers and usually requires replacing the front door handle assembly. To make sure I give you the correct part for your specific machine, please tell me the model number once you find it.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]

Just looked inside the door recess, can't see a model number sticker there. The plastic tongue on the door has snapped off though, found the piece on the floor. If I hold the door shut and press start it runs, stops when I let go.

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
This is why the machine won't start: the safety switch inside isn't being triggered because the door can't latch properly. You will need to replace the front door handle and catch assembly. As you couldn't find the model number sticker in the recess, try looking on the back of the machine or inside the door frame edge (sometimes hidden behind a small flap). Once you have that number, I can help you identify the correct part.
